scripts.build:bin: bun run --cwd ../.. blueprint:compile && SUPERFIELD_BUILD_VERSION=$(git describe --tags --always 2>/dev/null || echo dev) SUPERFIELD_BUILD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) SUPERFIELD_BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) SUPERFIELD_BUILD_BLUEPRINT_COMMIT=$(git -C ../../blueprint rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) bun build --compile ./bin/superfield.ts --outfile "$HOME/.bun/bin/superfield"
scripts.build:compile: bun run --cwd ../.. blueprint:compile && mkdir -p dist && SUPERFIELD_BUILD_VERSION=$(git describe --tags --always 2>/dev/null || echo dev) SUPERFIELD_BUILD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) SUPERFIELD_BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) SUPERFIELD_BUILD_BLUEPRINT_COMMIT=$(git -C ../../blueprint rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64-modern --outfile dist/superfield-linux-amd64 ./bin/superfield.ts
scripts.build:compile:arm64: bun run --cwd ../.. blueprint:compile && mkdir -p dist && SUPERFIELD_BUILD_VERSION=$(git describe --tags --always 2>/dev/null || echo dev) SUPERFIELD_BUILD_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) SUPERFIELD_BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) SUPERFIELD_BUILD_BLUEPRINT_COMMIT=$(git -C ../../blueprint rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo unknown) bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-arm64 --outfile dist/superfield-linux-arm64 ./bin/superfield.ts
scripts.build:compile:all: bun run build:compile && bun run build:compile:arm64
